attribution.note: Zitron endorses the denial and the absence-of-proof assertion; the opening profitability claim is the position he disputes.

semantics.note: No evidence is stronger than no proof. The context principally identifies OpenAI and Anthropic, without clearly extending the denial to every AI lab.

contract.note: The contract fairly separates inference profitability from company profitability and evidence from proof. Its ordinary reading is reasonable, but expense boundaries remain unspecified and 2025 cannot establish the ongoing position at publication.

evidence.note: Relevant estimates available before publication show positive gross margins but roughly break-even operating margins. Their model coverage, period and expense definitions do not establish the contracted profitability measure.
The interview confirms that the numerical illustration was hypothetical. It establishes neither actual inference profitability nor the absence of sufficient proof elsewhere.

The audited company filing provides substantial historical gross-margin counterevidence. Its 2025 period and expense classifications do not settle profitability at publication. Published before the evaluation cutoff but after the statement, it cannot refute the contemporaneous no-proof assertion.

reviews.rationale: The packet does not establish inference profitability on a comparable expense basis for the state described on March 31, 2026. Positive estimates and later audited gross margins merit consideration but do not settle that question. The documented search found no qualifying contemporaneous proof; that finding neither establishes unprofitability nor conclusively establishes the absence of public proof.
